pyqgis_plugin.name: Norte Agro - Uso do Solo
pyqgis_plugin.description: Land use mapping for rural properties in Brazil (CAR/SICAR): standard layers, area table (Excel) and KML. / Uso do solo para o CAR: camadas padronizadas, Quadro de Áreas e KML.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Norte Agro Projetos plugin for land use mapping of rural properties in Brazil (Rural Environmental Registry - CAR/SICAR). It creates and standardizes land use layers (Shapefile + QML styles) from an office catalog, recognizes layer names, checks and fixes overlaps and gaps, computes the area table (Excel) and a KML mirror, and loads SEMAD/SIGA (Goiás) reference layers. The user interface is in Brazilian Portuguese. Help videos are downloaded from the Norte Agro GitHub repository when internet is available. | Plugin da Norte Agro Projetos para o uso do solo de imóveis rurais (CAR/SICAR): cria e padroniza camadas, reconhece nomes, confere e corrige sobreposições, calcula o Quadro de Áreas (Excel) e o espelho KML e carrega as camadas da SEMAD (SIGA). Os vídeos da Ajuda são baixados do GitHub da Norte Agro quando há internet.

pyqgis_plugin.name: Norte Agro - Layout de plantas
pyqgis_plugin.description: Land use and environmental liabilities map layouts for rural properties in Brazil (CAR): legend, area tables, north arrow, scale and location map. / Plantas de Uso do Solo e de Passivos para o CAR.
pyqgis_plugin.about: Norte Agro Projetos plugin that builds the Land Use map and the Environmental Liabilities map of a rural property in Brazil (CAR) from templates: it reads the CAR receipt and the property registry PDF locally, uses the area table produced by the "Norte Agro - Uso do Solo" plugin and generates the layout with legend, area tables, north arrow, scale, municipality location and the technical manager block (filled in Settings). Each map has its own layers, CRS and extent; variable texts use project variables (@na_*). Optional OCR for scanned documents uses a separate Python environment that the user installs (support folder). The user interface is in Brazilian Portuguese. | Plugin da Norte Agro Projetos que gera a Planta de Uso do Solo e a Planta de Passivos do imóvel a partir de modelos, lendo o recibo do CAR, a matrícula e o Quadro de Áreas do plugin "Norte Agro - Uso do Solo". O responsável técnico é preenchido em Configurações.
